verdict.rationale: Browserbase is a browser-infrastructure API, so automatic cost-optimized configuration selection is a fair axis for it. However, nothing in the evidence shows the API automatically choosing the cheapest setup that still succeeds. The dashboard Optimize tool turns a completed Agent run into a Stagehand script or a better system prompt; that is an adjacent feature, not automatic cost-based configuration selection.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let the API automatically pick the cheapest configuration that still succeeds
